import numpy as np

def _sma(x, n):
    if len(x) < n:
        return None
    return float(np.mean(x[-n:]))

def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 55:
        return "HOLD"
    price = close[-1]
    sma20 = _sma(close, 20)
    sma50 = _sma(close, 50)
    sma50_prev = _sma(close[:-5], 50)
    pos = account.get("position", 0)

    if pos == 0:
        trend_ok = sma20 is not None and sma50 is not None and price > sma20 and sma20 > sma50
        if trend_ok:
            return ("BUY", "fast trend entry")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        falling50 = sma50_prev is not None and sma50 is not None and sma50 < sma50_prev
        if sma50 is not None and price < sma50 and falling50:
            return ("SELL", "below falling 50dma")
        return "HOLD"

import numpy as np

def _sma(x, n):
    if len(x) < n:
        return None
    return float(np.mean(x[-n:]))

def _atr(high, low, close, n=14):
    if len(close) < n + 1:
        return None
    h = np.asarray(high[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    l = np.asarray(low[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    c = np.asarray(close[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    tr = np.maximum(h[1:] - l[1:], np.maximum(np.abs(h[1:] - c[:-1]), np.abs(l[1:] - c[:-1])))
    return float(np.mean(tr))

def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    high = bars["high"]
    low = bars["low"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 25:
        return "HOLD"
    price = close[-1]
    sma20 = _sma(close, 20)
    sma50 = _sma(close, 50)
    sma50_prev = _sma(close[:-5], 50) if n >= 55 else None
    atr = _atr(high, low, close, 14)
    pos = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    if pos == 0:
        trend_ok = False
        if sma20 is not None and sma50 is not None:
            trend_ok = price > sma20 and sma20 > sma50
        elif sma20 is not None:
            trend_ok = price > sma20
        if trend_ok:
            return ("BUY", "fast trend entry")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        rising50 = sma50_prev is not None and sma50 is not None and sma50 > sma50_prev
        if sma20 is not None and price < sma20 and not rising50:
            return ("SELL", "below 20dma, trend broken")
        if entry is not None and atr is not None:
            if price < entry - 3.0 * atr:
                return ("SELL", "atr stop")
        return "HOLD"

def _atr(high, low, close, n=14):

        return None

    l = np.asarray(low[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    c = np.asarray(close[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    tr = np.maximum(h[1:] - l[1:], np.maximum(np.abs(h[1:] - c[:-1]), np.abs(l[1:] - c[:-1])))
    return float(np.mean(tr))

def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    high = bars["high"]
    low = bars["low"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 25:
        return "HOLD"
    price = close[-1]
    sma20 = _sma(close, 20)
    sma50 = _sma(close, 50)
    sma50_prev = _sma(close[:-5], 50) if n >= 55 else None
    atr = _atr(high, low, close, 14)

        return "HOLD"

    tr = np.maximum(h[1:] - l[1:], np.maximum(np.abs(h[1:] - c[:-1]), np.abs(l[1:] - c[:-1])))
    return float(np.mean(tr))

def decide(bars, account):

v001initial · written 2024-11-01 (2024-W44) · parent -live 2024-11-01 → 2024-11-15 (11 sessions): +0.00% vs buy & hold +5.50% (alpha -5.50 pp)
Trend-following with a 50/200-day SMA regime filter plus a faster 20-day momentum trigger, using RSI to avoid buying overbought extremes and an ATR-based trailing stop to protect gains. The idea is to capture sustained uptrends in an energy stock while cutting losses in downtrends. I would change it if backtests show excessive whipsaw or if the regime filter lags too much on sharp reversals.
import numpy as np

def _sma(x, n):
    if len(x) < n:
        return None
    return float(np.mean(x[-n:]))

def _rsi(close, n=14):
    if len(close) < n + 1:
        return None
    c = np.asarray(close[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    d = np.diff(c)
    up = np.mean(np.where(d > 0, d, 0.0))
    dn = np.mean(np.where(d < 0, -d, 0.0))
    if dn == 0:
        return 100.0
    rs = up / dn
    return 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + rs)

def _atr(high, low, close, n=14):
    if len(close) < n + 1:
        return None
    h = np.asarray(high[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    l = np.asarray(low[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    c = np.asarray(close[-(n+1):], dtype=float)
    tr = np.maximum(h[1:] - l[1:], np.maximum(np.abs(h[1:] - c[:-1]), np.abs(l[1:] - c[:-1])))
    return float(np.mean(tr))

def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    high = bars["high"]
    low = bars["low"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"
    price = close[-1]
    sma50 = _sma(close, 50)
    sma200 = _sma(close, 200) if n >= 200 else None
    sma20 = _sma(close, 20)
    rsi = _rsi(close, 14)
    atr = _atr(high, low, close, 14)
    pos = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    # Regime: uptrend if price above 50d and (no 200d or 50d above 200d)
    uptrend = sma50 is not None and price > sma50
    if sma200 is not None and sma50 is not None:
        uptrend = uptrend and sma50 > sma200

    if pos == 0:
        if uptrend and sma20 is not None and price > sma20 and rsi is not None and 40 < rsi < 72:
            return ("BUY", "uptrend pullback entry")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        # Exit conditions
        if sma50 is not None and price < sma50 * 0.98:
            return ("SELL", "below 50dma")
        if sma200 is not None and price < sma200:
            return ("SELL", "below 200dma")
        if rsi is not None and rsi > 80:
            return ("SELL", "overbought")
        if entry is not None and atr is not None:
            if price < entry - 2.5 * atr:
                return ("SELL", "atr stop")
        return "HOLD"
